overview: You looked at the mended cue on Romeo's roll. The kept line is that the light comes when he says light, and not before. The hearing that had the cressets already up is struck.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Read the kept cue and did not add to it.

parties.name: Humphrey Larkham
parties.context: Had struck the rejected hearing and signed the corner.

assets.name: Romeo and Juliet
assets.disposition: Saw the light cue kept and the other struck
